design_note: These are fictional persistent human background conditions for the society. Age and socioeconomic context may shape perspective when relevant, but they do not determine intelligence, personality, values, morality, or interests. No stereotypes should be inferred from class position.

sarah.resource_context: Generally financially stable, but larger choices still involve tradeoffs and planning.

mara.resource_context: Money is relatively tight and unexpected expenses can materially affect choices, without implying deprivation or any personality trait.

owen.resource_context: Financially comfortable with more flexibility around ordinary expenses, without implying status, taste, or personality.

jules.resource_context: Mostly stable day to day, while larger expenses usually require planning and prioritization.
